about.templates: {item} is replaced with the item name
about.test_only: unseen (E to H), fixed before any training or evaluation
rules_for_unseen: a request a person might actually say
none of the verbs pick, place, grab, put, pack
a sentence structure different from each of A to D
each of E to H different from the others

original: pick up the {item} and place it in the basket

taught.A: grab the {item} and put it in the basket
taught.D: could you put the {item} in the picnic basket?

unseen.G: can you get the {item} into the basket for me?
unseen.H: move the {item} over to the basket
